streamer_listing.scope: Existing incomplete dated positive list, unchanged; not a streamer census

limitations: Audience proxies are post-panel and selectively observed.
Absence of a positive flag is not observed absence of an audience.
These are descriptive group comparisons, not causal audience effects.
No historical pre-material result is substituted or used as a pass target.
Rare recorded chooser-loss anomalies retain their reviewed non-grant coding.
